title: Vectors: Multi-hop relay signature chain

Note: vector no_forward_beyond_max_hops is divergent (impl rejects HOP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED vs vector/spec-9.3 install-without-relay) - filed as separate beads issue, pinned by test_announce_beyond_max_hops_documented_divergence.
